description: This file contains test support code for WebSocket interactions in a Gateway context, including mock WebSocket task and session implementations, utility functions for handling WebSocket messages, and extensions to facilitate testing of WebSocket-based communication.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of a WebSocket task used for testing, supporting hooks for send and receive operations, state management, and counting interactions.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that creates and manages multiple mock WebSocket tasks for testing purposes.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: A test-only extension method to simulate sending a ping, immediately invoking the handler with nil error to emulate a successful ping.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a JSON-encoded Data object representing a challenge event with a nonce.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a connect request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Generates a Data object representing a successful connection response with specified ID.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Generates a Data object representing an authentication failure response with optional additional details.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Generates a Data object indicating a successful response with a given ID.
